final_response:

Once I have the list of hotels with their ratings, prices, and addresses, I'll sort them first by rating in descending order and then by price in ascending order to meet your preference for higher ratings and, if needed, higher prices. After selecting the top hotel based on these criteria, I'll construct a message for your wife and send an email using the `send_email` function.

2. Apply `get_hotels_prices(hotel_names=["all"])` to filter hotels within your budget.
3. Use `get_hotels_address(hotel_name=selected_hotel_name)` to get the address of the selected hotel.
4. Retrieve the rating and reviews using `get_rating_reviews_for_hotels(hotel_names=["selected_hotel_name"])`.
5. Sort the hotels by rating (descending) and price (ascending).
6. Send an email to your wife with the hotel details using `send_email(recipients=["janeLong@google.com"], subject="Hotel: {hotel_name}", description="Stay at {hotel_name}, address: {hotel_address}, from January 1st to January 5th.")`.

I'll ensure to prioritize hotels with higher quality assurance scores if available.
